requirement: This code should implement a function block named FB_MusicStopCommand that controls a CD player's stop functionality. It should include a method Execute that stops the CD player if a valid reference to the CD player is present. The reference to the CD player, refCDPlayer, should be of type REFERENCE TO FB_CDPlayer. The Execute method should check the validity of refCDPlayer using __ISVALIDREF and call the Stop method on refCDPlayer if the reference is valid. Additionally, the function block should have an initialization method, FB_init, which accepts two BOOLEAN inputs, bInitRetains and bInCopyCode, and a REFERENCE TO FB_CDPlayer named refCDPlayer. This method should set the internal reference THIS^.refCDPlayer to the input refCDPlayer if it is valid, otherwise, it should set THIS^.refCDPlayer to 0.
requirement_cn: 此代码应实现一个名为 FB_MusicStopCommand 的功能块，用于控制 CD 播放器的停止功能。它应包括一个 Execute 方法，如果存在对 CD 播放器的有效引用，则停止 CD 播放器。CD 播放器的引用 refCDPlayer 应为 REFERENCE TO FB_CDPlayer 类型。Execute 方法应使用 __ISVALIDREF 检查 refCDPlayer 的有效性，如果引用有效，则调用 refCDPlayer 上的 Stop 方法。此外，功能块应有一个初始化方法 FB_init，该方法接受两个 BOOLEAN 输入 bInitRetains 和 bInCopyCode，以及一个名为 refCDPlayer 的 REFERENCE TO FB_CDPlayer。此方法应在输入 refCDPlayer 有效时，将内部引用 THIS^.refCDPlayer 设置为输入的 refCDPlayer，否则将 THIS^.refCDPlayer 设置为 0。
